checks.name: Service route coverage
checks.detail: The matrix is intended to cover each professional_service route exactly once and match its canonical destination.

checks.name: Snapshot freshness preservation
checks.detail: Reported crawl ages and retrieval modes are retained; cache misses remain separate from HTTP status.

checks.name: Currentness and rights guardrails
checks.detail: The validator rejects promotion of stale observations to current scope, contract terms, rights or live HTTP/form states.

checks.name: Regression tests
checks.detail: Nine negative/positive checks will run under repo-integrity CI.

checks.name: Naming gate
checks.detail: The repository naming checks will run under the required workflow.

checks.name: External changes
checks.detail: No official-site edit, form submission, profile change, public publication or Pages deployment.

no_claims: No claim that all route pages are currently served or accessible.
No claim of current pricing, commercial terms, rights or production capacity.
No claim that cache misses are 404s or outages.
No claim of AI discovery, ranking, referral or conversion improvement.
